has a limited, rule-bound representation."],"overturn_conditions":["If empirical studies show expert intuition has lower variance than non-expert panel averaging for certain task structures.","If the trained non-expert panel using an explicit checklist produces more reliable judgments than a single intuition-reliant expert because the checklist externalizes the cognitive operations that constitute underperform.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Expert intuition is a high-variance stochastic retrieval process over a
